Read after the list and the household on the hidden surface, which stays on each owned page long enough for a pass (core: OWNED_STAY_MS). 2026-09-22 12:00: the reader marks the report ownedComplete when it reached the end of the library; core drops a title absent from two complete passes in a row.

verified.videoRemoveContinue: 2026-09-23 - an internal interface (the video rule allows it, spec Decision 2026-09-23): the site shows no remove for Continue Watching, but its own page code has one - deleteBookmark, sending the director operation bookmarkRemove - wrapped by an export that asks the page's app container (the component holding `hoggle`) for the signed-in user. The script finds the module by 'bookmarkRemove' in its source and the export by 'deleteBookmark' + 'ensureAuthenticated' (not by minified names), takes the container from the component tree, and runs it for the card's contentId. Verified live: Coraline (162088) -> 'success', the Continue Watching page empty after a reload. Continue Watching = the account's bookmarks (resume points), so removing also forgets the resume point.

notes: VS-8 (Phase 1, 2026-09-20): Fandango at Home, the former Vudu (vudu.com redirects here). Buy / rent plus a free ad-supported tier; My Library is the person's OWNED titles (nearly two thousand here - a library, not a list); My Watchlist (/content/browse/mywishlist) is what the person has started and not finished - the Continue watching row (2026-09-22); the person's own named Lists live at /mylists. Sign in inside the tile; sessions persist (section 10). DRM check, library, context and the play path wait for a signed-in account on the wall. 2026-09-24: the owned walk read 973 of 1,917 My Movies titles - the grid draws one 75-title batch at a time (about 2 s to fetch, placed above the viewport, whatever the page height), and the walk moved on as soon as the drawn set changed, which a leftover part of the old batch satisfied. Now each step is 85% of the drawn batch's height and waits until titles it had not drawn before appear and hold (6 s at most); the end waits 3 s for the list to grow; a walk that finds no grid yet restarts. 1,917 in ~93 s, My TV 61 in 15 s. 2026-09-24: videoOwnedArtWide - Fandango's own landscape still (images2.vudu.com/background/<id>-1280, 1280x720, every title checked) is a Library card's picture when TMDB has no backdrop; TMDB stays first because Fandango darkens these for its details page. placard2/<id> (the catalog's placardUrl) answers 404 for every title tried.
